text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Nishino Flower,
who hasn't been in the best shape lately.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Give a slight bow before passing through the torii gate, and avoid walking down the center of the path...
choice_data_list: You sure know your shrine etiquette.
You really know your shrine etiquette, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I saw someone praying like that once,
so I looked it up and practiced.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're asking for a favor from the gods,
we must make sure not to be disrespectful, right!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall go and offer my prayers.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Dear gods, thank you so much
for always watching over me.
Please continue to look after me from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: You were bowing a lot, big sis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A girl who had been watching Nishino Flower from the side
called out to her with a curious look.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When you make a wish to the gods,
you bow twice, clap twice,
and then bow one more time, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right, should we try doing it together?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: (*bow, bow, clap clap, bow*)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's it, you did a great job.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, the voice of a woman calling out to a young girl could be heard in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Mommy!
Bye-bye, big sister!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Buh-by~e.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That was adorable.
It kind of made me feel like a big sister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower smiled with satisfaction, and managed to get back in top form afterwards!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: First, make an offering... Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I forgot my wallet...
Even though I had prepared 115 yen for good fortune...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly checked my wallet,
but as luck would have it, I didn't have any loose change.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about it, Trainer.
It's my fault for being so clumsy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower felt deeply discouraged, and remained in a slump even after this day...
